sources.title: Senator Bill Cassidy Blocks Trump Pick to Head Science Agency
Trump abandons his FDA nominee, and Senate scraps vote on his NSF pick
Senate panel derails Trump’s controversial pick for NSF director

en.title: Senate panel derails Trump's picks for FDA and NSF leadership
en.dek: Senate Health Committee scrambles after two Trump nominees face sudden opposition.
facts: Jim O'Neill, a venture capitalist and Peter Thiel ally, faced bipartisan concern over whether he would stand up for science to lead the National Science Foundation [S1][S3].
Heidi Overton, a top White House domestic policy aide, withdrew her FDA nomination after facing criticism over her stances on vaccines, abortion, vapes, and birth control [S2].
Senator Bill Cassidy stated O'Neill did not do enough to stand up for science and against irresponsible decisions from Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. [S2].
Cassidy cited O'Neill's role in the firing of CDC Director Susan Monarez as a specific concern raised by committee members [S2].
Overton's nomination was withdrawn after some anti-abortion senators sought commitments from her that they could not get, according to Cassidy [S2].
body: Late Tuesday evening, Axios reported that the White House had abruptly withdrawn its controversial nomination of Heidi Overton to lead the FDA [S2].

Overton, a top conservative domestic policy aide, faced bipartisan skepticism over her stances on vaccines, abortion, vapes, and birth control, and consistently refused to directly answer senators' questions during her confirmation hearing in September [S2].

In a social media post Tuesday night, Senator Bill Cassidy said he believed Overton had a viable confirmation path, but noted the administration withdrew her rather than make commitments on abortion that anti-abortion senators could not get [S2].

After Overton's withdrawal, the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee's agenda for Wednesday was updated to scrap a scheduled vote on Jim O'Neill, Trump's nominee to run the NSF [S2].

In remarks this morning, Cassidy said that O'Neill did not do enough to stand up for science and against irresponsible decisions from Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., specifically referencing O'Neill's role in the firing of CDC Director Susan Monarez [S2][S3].
en.context: The Senate was considering nominees to lead the Food and Drug Administration and the National Science Foundation. Both faced scrutiny during the confirmation process [S1][S2][S3].

de.title: Senatsausschuss behindert Trumps Kandidaten für FDA und NSF-Führung
de.dek: Senatsgesundheitsausschuss im Chaos: Zwei Trump-Nominierte stehen plötzlich im Widerstand
facts: Jim O'Neill, Venture-Capital-Investor und Peter-Thiel-Verbündeter, erntete parteiübergreifende Sorge, ob er für Wissenschaft einstehen würde, um die National Science Foundation zu leiten
Heidi Overton, führende White-House-Innenpolitik-Beraterin, zog ihre FDA-Nominierung zurück nach Kritik an ihren Positionen zu Impfstoffen, Abtreibung, Vapes und Verhütungsmitteln
Senator Bill Cassidy: O'Neill habe nicht genug für Wissenschaft und gegen verantwortungslose Entscheidungen von Gesundheitsminister Robert F. Kennedy Jr. eingetreten
Cassidy verwies auf O'Neill Rolle bei der Entlassung von CDC-Chef Susan Monarez als konkretes Anliegen der Ausschussmitglieder
Overton Nominierung zurückgezogen nach Bestrebungen anti-abtreibungs Senatoren, aus ihr Verpflichtungen zu erhalten, die sie nicht bekommen konnten, so Cassidy
body: Spät am Dienstagabend berichtete Axios, dass das Weiße Haus seine umstrittene Nominierung von Heidi Overton zur Leitung der FDA plötzlich zurückgezogen hatte [S2].

Overton, eine führende konservative Beraterin für Inlandspolitik, stand wegen ihrer Positionen zu Impfungen, Abtreibung, E-Zigaretten und Verhütungsmitteln im bipartisanen Skeptizismus und wich während ihrer Anhörung im September konsequent einer direkten Antwort auf Fragen der Senatoren aus [S2].

In einem Social-Media-Beitrag am Dienstagabend sagte Senator Bill Cassidy, er glaube, Overton hätte einen tragfähigen Bestätigungsweg, wies jedoch darauf hin, dass die Administration sie lieber zurückgezogen habe, statt Zusagen zu Abtreibung zu machen, die anti-abortive Senatoren nicht akzeptieren könnten [S2].

Nachdem Overton ihre Nominierung zurückgezogen hatte, wurde der Zeitplan des Senatsausschusses für Gesundheit, Bildung, Arbeit und Renten am Mittwoch aktualisiert und einen geplanten Abstimmungsvorschlag zu Jim O'Neill, Trumps Nominierung für die Leitung des NSF, gestrichen [S2].

In seinen Aussagen am Morgen sagte Cassidy, O'Neill habe nicht genug getan, um für Wissenschaft einzustehen und gegen unverantwortliche Entscheidungen von Gesundheitsminister Robert F. Kennedy Jr. vorzugehen, und bezog sich dabei speziell auf O'Neill Rolle bei der Entlassung von CDC-Direktorin Susan Monarez [S2][S3].
de.context: Der Senat prüfte Nominierte für die Leitung von FDA und National Science Foundation. Beide standen während des Bestätigungsverfahrens unter Beobachtung.

pt.title: Painel do Senado derruta nomeações de Trump para liderar FDA e NSF
pt.dek: Comité de Saúde do Senado em pânico após dois nomeados de Trump enfrentarem oposição repentina
facts: Jim O'Neill, capitalista de risco e aliado de Peter Thiel, enfrentou preocupação bipartidista sobre se defenderia a ciência para liderar a National Science Foundation
Heidi Overton, alta assessora doméstica da Casa Branca, retirou a nomeação para liderar a FDA após críticas sobre as suas posições sobre vacinas, aborto, vapes e anticoncepcionais
O senador Bill Cassidy afirmou que O'Neill não fez o suficiente para defender a ciência e contra decisões irresponsáveis do secretário de Saúde Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
Cassidy citou o papel de O'Neill no despedimento do diretor do CDC, Susan Monarez, como uma preocupação específica levantada pelos membros do comité
A nomeação de Overton foi retirada após alguns senadores anti-aborto buscarem compromissos que não conseguiram obter, segundo Cassidy
body: Na terça-feira à noite, o Axios informou que a Casa Branca retirou abruptamente a controvérsia nomeação de Heidi Overton para liderar a FDA [S2].

Overton, uma principal assistente política doméstica conservadora, enfrentou ceticismo bipartidário sobre as suas posições sobre vacinas, aborto, cigarros eletrónicos e contraceção, e recusou-se consistentemente a responder diretamente às perguntas dos senadores durante a sua audição de confirmação em setembro [S2].

Em um post nas redes sociais na terça-feira à noite, o senador Bill Cassidy disse que acreditava que Overton tinha um caminho viável de confirmação, mas salientou que a administração retirou-a antes de fazer compromissos sobre o aborto que senadores contra o aborto não conseguiram obter [S2].

Após a retirada de Overton, a agenda do Comité do Senado de Saúde, Educação, Trabalho e Pensões para quarta-feira foi atualizada para cancelar o voto agendado sobre Jim O'Neill, nomeação de Trump para dirigir o NSF [S2].

Em declarações esta manhã, Cassidy afirmou que O'Neill não fez o suficiente para defender a ciência e contra decisões irresponsáveis da secretária de Saúde Robert F. Kennedy Jr., referindo especificamente o papel de O'Neill no despedimento do diretor do CDC, Susan Monarez.
pt.context: O Senado estava a considerar nomeados para liderar a Food and Drug Administration e a National Science Foundation. Ambos enfrentaram escrutínio durante o processo de confirmação.

zh.title: 参议院委员会阻挠特朗普提名的FDA和NSF负责人
zh.dek: 参议院卫生委员会在特朗普两名提名人面临突遭反对时措手不及
facts: 吉姆·奥尼尔是一位风险投资人，特朗普盟友彼得·蒂尔的支持者，面临两党对其是否会为科学立场的质疑，将领导国家科学基金会 [S1][S3]
海迪·奥弗顿是白宫国内政策事务的高级助手，因在疫苗、堕胎、电子烟和避孕药等问题上的立场受到批评后，撤回了她的FDA提名 [S2]
参议员比尔·卡西迪表示，奥尼尔未能足够坚定地为科学立场发声，并反对卫生部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr. 的鲁莽决定 [S2]
卡西迪引用了奥尼尔解雇疾控中心主任苏珊·莫纳兹的角色，作为委员会成员提出的具体担忧 [S2]
根据卡西迪的说法，奥弗顿的提名在一些反堕胎参议员寻求得到她无法提供的承诺后被撤回 [S2]
body: 晚间晚些时候，Axios 报道称，白宫突然撤回了有争议的提名人海迪·奥弗顿，她原本被提名负责食品药品监督管理局（FDA）[S2]。
奥弗顿是顶级的保守派国内政策助手，因在疫苗、堕胎、电子烟和避孕药等问题上的立场，受到两党的怀疑，且在去年九月的提名听证会上，一再拒绝直接回答参议员的问题[S2]。
周二晚在社交媒体上，比利·卡西迪参议员表示，他认为奥弗顿有可行的提名路径，但指出行政部门撤回她的提名，是为了避免就堕胎问题作出承诺，这让反堕胎参议员无法接受[S2]。
在奥弗顿撤回提名后，参议院健康、教育、劳工和养老委员会周三的议程被更新，取消了对吉姆·奥尼尔的投票，他原本是特朗普提名负责国家科学基金会（NSF）的候选人[S2]。
卡西迪在今早的讲话中表示，奥尼尔未能足够坚定地为科学立场，特别是针对卫生部长罗伯特·F·肯尼迪 Jr. 的不负责任决策，他特别提到了奥尼尔在解雇疾控中心主任苏珊·莫纳雷兹一事中的角色。
zh.context: 参议院正在考虑提名者担任食品药品监督管理局和国家科学基金会负责人一职。两人在确认过程中都受到了审查 [S1][S2][S3]

ko.title: 상원 위원회, 트럼프 FDA·NSF 지도부 후보자 임명안 무산
ko.dek: 상원 보건위원회, 트럼프 지명자 2명 갑작스런 반대 직면하며 급히 진척
facts: 짐 오닐, 벤처 캐피털리스트이자 피터 티엘 지지자, 국립과학재단 수장 후보자로서 과학 옹호 의지 의문 제기돼 양당 우려
하이디 오버턴, 백악관 수석 국내정책 보좌관, 백신·낙태·전자담배·피임 관련 입장 비판에 FDA 후보자직 사퇴
빌 캐시디 상원의원, 오닐이 과학 옹호와 로버트 F. 케네디 주니어 보건장관의 무책임한 결정에 반대하는 데 충분치 않다고 평가
캐시디 상원의원, 오닐이 CDC 수장 스usan 모나레즈 해고에 관여한 점을 위원회가 우려로 제기한 구체적 사안으로 언급
오버턴 후보자, 일부 반낙태 의원들이 그녀에게 약속을 요구했으나 Cassidy 의원 "얻지 못했다"며 후보자직 사퇴
body: 상원 위원회, 트럼프 FDA·NSF 지도부 후보자 임명안 무산
Axios는 화요일 저녁, 백악관이 FDA 수장을 맡게 된 헤디 오버턴 후보자의 논란이 되는 임명안을 갑자기 철회했다고 보도했다.
오버턴은 보수 진영의 주요 국내 정책 보좌관으로, 백신·낙태·전자담배·피임 등 문제에 대해 상원 청문회에서 일관되게 직접적인 답변을 피해 양당으로부터 skepticism(의심)을 샀다.
화요일 밤 SNS에 상원 Bill Cassidy 의원은 오버턴이 타당한 임명 경로가 있다고 믿지만, 반(反) 낙태 의원들이 수용할 수 있는 낙태 관련 약속을 하기보다는 후보자를 철회했다고 밝혔다.
오버턴의 사퇴 이후, 상원 보건·교육·노동·연금 위원회는 수요일 일정에 scheduled vote(예정 투표)를 취소하고 트럼프 행정부 NSF 수장 지명자 짐 오닐에 대한 투표 항목을 삭제했다. Cassidy 의원은 이날 오닐이 과학을 옹호하고 보건복지부 Robert F. 케네디 주니어 장관의 임의적인 결정에 맞서지 못했다는 점을 언급했다.
ko.context: FDA와 국립과학재단 수장을 지명하는 상원 인준안이 검토되는 과정에서 양 후보 모두 scrutiny(검증) 받아

problemsFixed: Facts in 'facts' array and 'body' are not consistently sourced or paraphrased from the provided texts. Claims like 'Cassidy cited O'Neill's role' and 'Overton withdrew her nomination' need precise attribution. Headline uses 'blocks' which is not the final outcome described in sources. Body contains vague phrasing ('faced bipartisan concern') without exact attribution. 'Context' section contains evaluative framing ('about their qualifications'). Body ends with an evaluative summary sentence. Rhythm issues: multiple short sentences in a row. Opening noun repetition between paragraphs.
